'''Aika Lars''' was the first wife of [[Cliegg Lars/Legends|Cliegg Lars]] and the mother of [[Owen Lars/Legends|Owen Lars]]. She was from the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Ator/Legends|Ator]], and [[Death/Legends|died]] when Owen was very young. Stricken with grief, Cliegg returned to his own [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] with Owen to raise him on his [[Lars family/Legends|family's]] [[Lars homestead/Legends|moisture farm]].
